## AttributeDefinitionValue  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via InferOptionalAttributes
type AttributeDefinitionValue<Definition extends TelemetryAttributeDefinition> = Definition extends {
	type: "string";
	values: readonly (infer Value extends string)[];
}
	? Value
	: Definition extends { type: "string" }
		? string
		: Definition extends { type: "number"; values: readonly (infer Value extends number)[] }
			? Value
			: Definition extends { type: "number" }
				? number
				: Definition extends { type: "boolean"; values: readonly (infer Value extends boolean)[] }
					? Value
					: Definition extends { type: "boolean" }
						? boolean
						: Definition extends {
									type: "string[]";
									elementValues: readonly (infer Value extends string)[];
								}
							? readonly Value[]
							: Definition extends { type: "string[]" }
								? readonly string[]
								: Definition extends {
											type: "number[]";
											elementValues: readonly (infer Value extends number)[];
										}
									? readonly Value[]
									: Definition extends { type: "number[]" }
										? readonly number[]
										: Definition extends {
													type: "boolean[]";
													elementValues: readonly (infer Value extends boolean)[];
												}
											? readonly Value[]
											: readonly boolean[];

 * Bind an explicit parent context to the combined span vocabulary of one or more schemas.
 * Schema values are used only for type inference; no runtime schema validation is performed.

	telemetryContext: TelemetryContext,
	_schemas: Schemas & UniqueTelemetrySchemas<Schemas>,

## DuplicateTelemetrySpanNames  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via createTypedSpanStarter
type DuplicateTelemetrySpanNames<
	Schemas extends readonly TelemetrySchemaDefinition[],
	Seen extends string = never,
> = Schemas extends readonly [
	infer Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition,
	...infer Rest extends readonly TelemetrySchemaDefinition[],
]
	?
			| Extract<TelemetrySchemaSpanName<Schema>, Seen>
			| DuplicateTelemetrySpanNames<Rest, Seen | TelemetrySchemaSpanName<Schema>>
	: never;

type EventArguments<
	Definitions extends Record<string, TelemetryEventAttributeDefinition>,
	Attributes extends InferEventAttributes<Definitions>,
> = [RequiredAttributeNames<Definitions>] extends [never]
	? [attributes?: ExactTelemetryAttributes<InferEventAttributes<Definitions>, Attributes>]
	: [attributes: ExactTelemetryAttributes<InferEventAttributes<Definitions>, Attributes>];

## InferOptionalAttributes  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
export type InferOptionalAttributes<Definitions extends Record<string, TelemetryAttributeDefinition>> =
	keyof Definitions extends never
		? Record<string, never>
		: { [Name in keyof Definitions]?: AttributeDefinitionValue<Definitions[Name]> };

## InferRequiredAndOptionalAttributes  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
export type InferRequiredAndOptionalAttributes<
	Definitions extends Record<string, TelemetryStartAttributeDefinition | TelemetryEventAttributeDefinition>,
> = keyof Definitions extends never
	? Record<string, never>
	: {
			[Name in RequiredAttributeNames<Definitions>]: AttributeDefinitionValue<Definitions[Name]>;
		} & {
			[Name in OptionalAttributeNames<Definitions>]?: AttributeDefinitionValue<Definitions[Name]>;
		};

## InferStartAttributes  telemetry/src/index.ts

export type InferStartAttributes<Definitions extends Record<string, TelemetryStartAttributeDefinition>> =
	InferRequiredAndOptionalAttributes<Definitions>;

## RequiredAttributeNames  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via InferRequiredAndOptionalAttributes
type RequiredAttributeNames<
	Definitions extends Record<string, TelemetryStartAttributeDefinition | TelemetryEventAttributeDefinition>,
> = {
	[Name in keyof Definitions]-?: Definitions[Name]["required"] extends true ? Name : never;
}[keyof Definitions];

## SchemaTelemetrySpan  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
export type SchemaTelemetrySpan<
	Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition,
	Name extends TelemetrySchemaSpanName<Schema>,
> = Omit<TelemetrySpan, "addEvent" | "setAttributes"> & {
	addEvent<
		EventName extends TelemetrySchemaSpanEventName<Schema, Name>,
		const Attributes extends InferEventAttributes<
			SchemaSpanEventAttributeDefinitions<Schema, Name, EventName>
		> = InferEventAttributes<SchemaSpanEventAttributeDefinitions<Schema, Name, EventName>>,
	>(
		name: EventName,
		...args: EventArguments<SchemaSpanEventAttributeDefinitions<Schema, Name, EventName>, Attributes>
	): void;
	setAttributes<const Attributes extends TelemetrySchemaSpanEndAttributes<Schema, Name>>(
		attributes: ExactTelemetryAttributes<TelemetrySchemaSpanEndAttributes<Schema, Name>, Attributes>,
	): void;
};

## StoredSpan  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
/**
 * A settled span snapshot, independent of the recording adapter. Times are milliseconds at microsecond resolution;
 * event times are relative to span start.
 */
export interface StoredSpan {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly traceId: string;
	readonly parentId?: string;
	readonly name: string;
	/** Wall-clock milliseconds since the epoch (`telemetryNow`). */
	readonly startedMs: number;
	readonly endedMs: number;
	readonly attributes: SpanAttributes;
	readonly events: readonly { readonly name: string; readonly timeMs: number; readonly attributes: SpanAttributes }[];
	readonly links: readonly {
		readonly traceId: string;
		readonly spanId: string;
		readonly attributes?: SpanAttributes;
	}[];
	readonly status: SpanStatus;
}

## TelemetryAttributeDefinition  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect; chord-effect via ChordSpanName
export type TelemetryAttributeDefinition = TelemetryAttributeMetadata &
	(
		| { type: "string"; values?: readonly string[]; examples?: readonly string[] }
		| { type: "number"; values?: readonly number[]; examples?: readonly number[] }
		| { type: "boolean"; values?: readonly boolean[]; examples?: readonly boolean[] }
		| { type: "string[]"; elementValues?: readonly string[]; examples?: readonly (readonly string[])[] }
		| { type: "number[]"; elementValues?: readonly number[]; examples?: readonly (readonly number[])[] }
		| { type: "boolean[]"; elementValues?: readonly boolean[]; examples?: readonly (readonly boolean[])[] }
	);

## TelemetryContext  telemetry/src/index.ts

/** Adapter contract for trusted typed inputs; malformed input behavior is unspecified. */
export interface TelemetryContext {
	/** Adapter capabilities remain available on child spans and extracted parents. */

	readonly propagation?: TelemetryPropagation;
	startSpan<T>(options: SpanOptions, callback: (span: TelemetrySpan) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
}

export type TelemetrySchemaSpanUnion<Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition> = {
	[Name in TelemetrySchemaSpanName<Schema>]: {
		name: Name;
		startAttributes: TelemetrySchemaSpanStartAttributes<Schema, Name>;
		endAttributes: TelemetrySchemaSpanEndAttributes<Schema, Name>;
		events: {
			[EventName in TelemetrySchemaSpanEventName<Schema, Name>]: TelemetrySchemaSpanEventAttributes<
				Schema,
				Name,
				EventName
			>;
		};
	};
}[TelemetrySchemaSpanName<Schema>];

export interface TelemetryStore {
	findTraces(query?: TraceQuery): Promise<{ traces: readonly StoredTrace[]; cursor?: string }>;

## TraceQuery  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
export interface TraceQuery {
	/** Name of the earliest stored span, with span ID breaking timestamp ties. */
	readonly name?: string;
	/** All equalities must match one span; that span may be anywhere in the trace. */
	readonly attributes?: Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>;
	readonly errors?: true;
	/** Inclusive bounds on the earliest stored span's start time. */
	readonly startMin?: number;
	readonly startMax?: number;
	/** Positive page size; defaults to 20. */
	readonly limit?: number;
	/** Opaque continuation from the previous page; retain the same filters. */
	readonly cursor?: string;
}

## TypedSpanStarter  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
/** A per-span overload set bound to one explicit parent context and one or more schemas. */
export type TypedSpanStarter<Schemas extends TelemetrySchemaTuple> = UnionToIntersection<
	{
		[Name in SpanNameInSchemas<Schemas>]: TypedSpanStarterForName<Schemas, Name>;
	}[SpanNameInSchemas<Schemas>]
>;

## TypedSpanStarterForName  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedSpanStarter
type TypedSpanStarterForName<Schemas extends TelemetrySchemaTuple, Name extends SpanNameInSchemas<Schemas>> = <
	const Attributes extends SpanStartAttributesInSchema<Schemas[number], Name>,
	Result,
>(
	name: Name,
	attributes: ExactTelemetryAttributes<SpanStartAttributesInSchema<Schemas[number], Name>, Attributes>,
	callback: (
		span: SpanInSchema<Schemas[number], Name>,
		startChildSpan: TypedSpanStarter<Schemas>,
	) => Result | Promise<Result>,
) => Promise<Result>;

## UnionToIntersection  telemetry/src/index.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedSpanStarter
type UnionToIntersection<Union> = (Union extends unknown ? (value: Union) => void : never) extends (
	value: infer Intersection,
) => void
	? Intersection
	: never;

type UniqueTelemetrySchemas<Schemas extends TelemetrySchemaTuple> = [DuplicateTelemetrySpanNames<Schemas>] extends [
	never,
]
	? unknown
	: { readonly "duplicate telemetry span names": DuplicateTelemetrySpanNames<Schemas> };

## InMemoryTelemetryContext  telemetry/src/memory.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
/**
 * Backend-neutral reference implementation that records spans in process memory.
 * Create a fresh instance to isolate tests or independent recording scopes.
 */
export class InMemoryTelemetryContext
	implements TelemetryContext, TelemetryPropagation, TelemetryMetrics, TelemetryStore
{
	readonly metrics: TelemetryMetrics
	readonly propagation: TelemetryPropagation
	startSpan<T>(options: SpanOptions, callback: (span: TelemetrySpan) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T>
	/** Returns a detached carrier for a known span or extracted parent, including settled spans. */
	inject(context: TelemetryContext): TelemetryCarrier | undefined
	/** Missing or non-string carrier identities fall back to this recorder's root context. */
	extract(carrier: TelemetryCarrier | undefined): TelemetryContext
	counter(name: string, options?: InstrumentOptions): TelemetryCounter
	upDownCounter(name: string, options?: InstrumentOptions): TelemetryUpDownCounter
	histogram(name: string, options?: HistogramOptions): TelemetryHistogram
	async getTrace(traceId: string): Promise<StoredTrace | undefined>
	async findTraces(query: TraceQuery = {}): Promise<{ traces: readonly StoredTrace[]; cursor?: string }>
	/** Read raw measurements as count-one rows, without changing getMetrics() snapshots. */
	async findMetrics(query: MetricQuery): Promise<readonly StoredMetric[]>
	/** Returns detached measurements in recording order, without aggregation. */
	getMetrics(): readonly RecordedTelemetryMeasurement[]
	/** Returns detached snapshots in span-start order. */
	getSpans(): readonly RecordedTelemetrySpan[]
}

	readonly context: Readonly<TelemetryCarrier> | null;

## RecordedTelemetrySpan  telemetry/src/memory.ts

export interface RecordedTelemetrySpan {
	readonly id: number;
	/** Local parent ID, or null for roots and parents owned by another recorder. */
	readonly parentId: number | null;
	readonly context: Readonly<TelemetryCarrier>;
	readonly parentContext: Readonly<TelemetryCarrier> | null;
	readonly links: readonly RecordedTelemetryLink[];
	readonly name: string;
	readonly attributes: Readonly<SpanAttributes>;
	readonly events: readonly RecordedTelemetryEvent[];
	readonly status: SpanStatus;
	readonly settled: boolean;
	readonly endSequence?: number;
}

## telemetryNow  telemetry/src/memory.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
/**
 * Now as milliseconds since the epoch, rounded to the microsecond: `performance.now()` (monotonic, sub-millisecond)
 * plus an anchor to the wall clock. While the two agree within 10 ms, times in one process keep their order and
 * spacing to the microsecond; past that the clock follows `Date.now()` again, at whole milliseconds. Every adapter
 * of this package and Chord's SQLite store stamp span starts with it, so their times agree.
 */
export function telemetryNow(): number

## createTypedMetrics  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
/** Bind instrument names, kinds, metadata, and exact measurement attributes to one or more schemas. */
export function createTypedMetrics<const Schemas extends MetricSchemas>(
	metrics: TelemetryMetrics,
	schemas: Schemas &
		([DuplicateMetricNames<Schemas>] extends [never]
			? unknown
			: { readonly "duplicate telemetry metric names": DuplicateMetricNames<Schemas> }),
): TypedTelemetryMetrics<Schemas>

## DuplicateMetricNames  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via createTypedMetrics
type DuplicateMetricNames<
	Schemas extends readonly TelemetrySchemaDefinition[],
	Seen extends string = never,
> = Schemas extends readonly [
	infer Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition,
	...infer Rest extends readonly TelemetrySchemaDefinition[],
]
	? Extract<keyof MetricsOf<Schema>, Seen> | DuplicateMetricNames<Rest, Seen | (keyof MetricsOf<Schema> & string)>
	: never;

export interface InstrumentOptions {
	description?: string;
	unit?: string;
}

## MeasurementArguments  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via SchemaTelemetryCounter
type MeasurementArguments<
	Definition extends TelemetryMetricDefinition,
	Attributes extends MetricAttributes<Definition>,
> = {
	[Name in keyof Definition["attributes"]]: Definition["attributes"][Name]["required"] extends true ? Name : never;
}[keyof Definition["attributes"]] extends never
	? [attributes?: ExactTelemetryAttributes<MetricAttributes<Definition>, Attributes>]
	: [attributes: ExactTelemetryAttributes<MetricAttributes<Definition>, Attributes>];

## MetricAttributes  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via SchemaTelemetryCounter
type MetricAttributes<Definition extends TelemetryMetricDefinition> = InferRequiredAndOptionalAttributes<
	Definition["attributes"]
>;

## MetricByName  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedTelemetryMetrics
type MetricByName<
	Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition,
	Name extends string,
> = Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition
	? Name extends keyof MetricsOf<Schema>
		? MetricsOf<Schema>[Name]
		: never
	: never;

## MetricKind  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedTelemetryMetrics
type MetricKind = TelemetryMetricDefinition["kind"];

## MetricNames  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedTelemetryMetrics
type MetricNames<
	Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition,
	Kind extends MetricKind,
> = Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition
	? {
			[Name in keyof MetricsOf<Schema>]: MetricsOf<Schema>[Name] extends { kind: Kind } ? Name : never;
		}[keyof MetricsOf<Schema>] &
			string
	: never;

## MetricSchemas  telemetry/src/metrics.ts

type MetricSchemas = readonly [TelemetrySchemaDefinition, ...TelemetrySchemaDefinition[]];

## MetricsOf  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect via TypedTelemetryMetrics
type MetricsOf<Schema extends TelemetrySchemaDefinition> = Schema extends {
	metrics: infer Metrics extends Record<string, TelemetryMetricDefinition>;
}
	? Metrics
	: Record<never, never>;

## SchemaTelemetryCounter  telemetry/src/metrics.ts

export type SchemaTelemetryCounter<Definition extends TelemetryMetricDefinition> = {
	add<const Attributes extends MetricAttributes<Definition> = MetricAttributes<Definition>>(
		value: number,
		...args: MeasurementArguments<Definition, Attributes>
	): void;
};

export type SchemaTelemetryHistogram<Definition extends TelemetryMetricDefinition> = {
	record<const Attributes extends MetricAttributes<Definition> = MetricAttributes<Definition>>(
		value: number,
		...args: [...MeasurementArguments<Definition, Attributes>, context?: TelemetryContext]
	): void;
};

## TelemetryMetricDefinition  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect; chord-effect via ChordSpanName
export type TelemetryMetricDefinition = {
	description: string;
	unit?: string;
	attributes: Record<string, TelemetryMetricAttributeDefinition>;
} & ({ kind: "counter" | "upDownCounter"; boundaries?: never } | { kind: "histogram"; boundaries?: readonly number[] });

## TelemetryMetrics  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect; agent-effect via Agent, ai-effect via ProviderRequestOptions, chord-effect via HostOptions, coding-agent-effect via ExtensionRunner, durable-effect via HarnessOptions, env-effect via LocalExecutionEnv, evals-effect via PiCodingAgentHarnessOptions
/**
 * Optional adapter capability with synchronous factories and recording methods.
 * Typed inputs are trusted; callers supply finite measurements and nonnegative counter increments.
 * Malformed input behavior is unspecified.
 */
export interface TelemetryMetrics {
	counter(name: string, options?: InstrumentOptions): TelemetryCounter;
	upDownCounter(name: string, options?: InstrumentOptions): TelemetryUpDownCounter;
	histogram(name: string, options?: HistogramOptions): TelemetryHistogram;
}

## TelemetryUpDownCounter  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect; agent-effect via Agent, ai-effect via ProviderRequestOptions, chord-effect via HostOptions, coding-agent-effect via ExtensionRunner, durable-effect via HarnessOptions, env-effect via LocalExecutionEnv, evals-effect via PiCodingAgentHarnessOptions
export interface TelemetryUpDownCounter {
	add(value: number, attributes?: SpanAttributes): void;
}

## TypedTelemetryMetrics  telemetry/src/metrics.ts
used by: telemetry-effect
export interface TypedTelemetryMetrics<Schemas extends MetricSchemas> {
	counter<Name extends MetricNames<Schemas[number], "counter">>(
		name: Name,
	): SchemaTelemetryCounter<MetricByName<Schemas[number], Name>>;
	upDownCounter<Name extends MetricNames<Schemas[number], "upDownCounter">>(
		name: Name,
	): SchemaTelemetryCounter<MetricByName<Schemas[number], Name>>;
	histogram<Name extends MetricNames<Schemas[number], "histogram">>(
		name: Name,
	): SchemaTelemetryHistogram<MetricByName<Schemas[number], Name>>;
}
